title: Account factory
source: lab/TARGETS.md section 6 row 14; section 3 (tenant isolation at the storage layer)
story: A new tenant is provisioned with 10k entities and its first release while other tenants are live.
checked: The new tenant is invisible to others at the storage layer; others' p99 holds.
rungNote: At 10k: 1,000 new-tenant subjects (3,000 entities, 12,000 facts) provisioned in bulk commands of 10 subjects.

witnesses.positive: new-tenant subjects (exist in their own tenant after provisioning)
witnesses.negative: existing-tenant trace subjects (their pulls never include new-tenant rows; reads of new-tenant ids through the existing route return nothing)

domain: the new tenant's first release activation evaluates its subjects (O-DOMAIN)

oracle.source: O-REPLAY per tenant (tenant-local state); hand derivation for isolation (cited in expected hand.isolation)
gaps: O-REPLAY has no tenancy rule: isolation is a storage property checked by the runner, not replayed
the runner needs one composition per tenant (DatabaseScope.make with the tenant); lib/composition.mjs supports it but the multi-tenant runner is not built

blockedReason: NOT_RUN: needs the multi-tenant runner (one composition per tenant, per-tenant metrics); not built
